name: cortex
description: Relative Cortex orchestration for reliable staged agent work with durable internal audit state.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate staged work across Codex agents
interface.longDescription: Adds 21 bundled agent profiles, 10 skills, evidence-first scope and planning gates, approval-fresh adaptive pipelines, scoped immutable dispatch briefings, governance policy and initiative management, and semantic attempt-event/result transport over the canonical local Cortex v10 task ledger with schema v15 integrity. Cortex preserves the exact user-authored request, binds native workers for compaction-safe recovery, requires observable task and microtask contracts, reconciles worker observations with database-backed immutable evidence, applies checksummed SQLite-to-SQLite schema migrations on plugin upgrades, and keeps receipt-backed gates, verification, maintenance, and handoff state.
interface.defaultPrompt: Coordinate this task with Cortex. Use help, harvest, harvest-refresh, or prune when that exact route is requested.
